title: MinimapPlayerMarkerChain (CORRECTED) - the minimap player marker follows the LIVE coords [0x777764]/[0x777768] = [screen+0x2F884C]/[+0x2F8850] (Y/X), which have exactly TWO writers (0x422A9E Y=word[item+6], 0x422AC5 X=word[item+8], the death/teleport pump handler 0x422960); the previously-targeted 0x7D9234/0x7D9238 pair is the death/respawn-check pair ONLY, not minimap input. Full chain: pump 0x422960 -> live coords -> tick 0x4294E0 -> 0x43D850(Y,X) update+map-texture draw + 0x43DA80 marker layers -> widget 0x48512C = [screen+0x6214]
objective: Correct the minimap data-source finding (Round 9 targeted the wrong address pair) and lock the complete minimap chain: which memory feeds the player dot, which handlers write it, the widget field table (D3D target rect byte-exact {672,0,800,128}), the map-texture binding rule (mapid < 0x3E8 -> MMap.wil frame mapid, >= 0x3E8 -> FMMap.wil frame mapid-1000), the marker layers (player box, blinking dot, object markers from [0x560070]/[0x5600A0]), and the map-loader sub-object ([esi+0xF5200] = 0x574118) fed by the decoded death/teleport payload = map name.
question: Where does the minimap player dot actually get its position? Which code writes those coordinates and when? What is the widget's full field map and draw sequence? What does the death/teleport handler (msgid 0x33/0x27A) do beyond zeroing the old pair?
method: Static disassembly of Mir3.exe raw bytes via capstone; exhaustive absolute-form writer scan for both live-coord addresses (89 {modrm}+abs32 all 8 base regs, C7 05, 8B {modrm}+abs32 all 8 regs, 66 89, C6 05) over the WHOLE file plus pointer-relative forms; reader-hit context dump (52 walk/collision hits 0x419C4E..0x41AF09, tick 0x42959C, HUD text 0x42A476, click-targets 0x42C1D4/0x42CDA4, death tail 0x422B05/0x422B0F); widget field table dump at 0x48512C ([screen+0x6214]); full disassembly of 0x43D850/0x43DA80/0x43DC54/0x43D780/0x43C9C0/0x43B600; string dump at 0x47C404 ('.\Map\%s.map' + FMMap/MMap paths + 'EDIT'); death-tail full dump 0x422B0F..0x422B60.

correction.old_claim: Round 9 targeted 0x7D9234/0x7D9238 = [0x35A31C]/[0x35A320] as the minimap player-marker position source
correction.corrected: 0x7D9234/0x7D9238 is the DEATH/RESPAWN-CHECK pair ONLY: read at 0x422985/0x42298B/0x422995 ('x-y < 9' defer check), zero-written at 0x422A15/0x422A1B in the death/teleport handler. It never feeds the minimap.
correction.actual_source: the minimap player marker follows the LIVE coordinates [0x777764]/[0x777768] = [screen+0x2F884C]/[+0x2F8850] (Y/X): tick 0x4294E0 reads both (8b 0d 64 77 77 00 / 8b 15 68 77 77 00) and pushes X then Y -> 0x43D850(Y, X)
correction.correction_c_number: see EVIDENCE-INVENTORY entry for this finding (correction to the Round 9 minimap entry)

verdict: CLOSED with correction - the minimap player marker is fed by the LIVE coords [0x777764]/[0x777768] (only writers 0x422A9E/0x422AC5 in the death/teleport handler; tick 0x4294E0 -> 0x43D850/0x43DA80 -> widget 0x48512C). 0x7D9234/0x7D9238 is the death/respawn-check pair only. The death/teleport payload is the map name and drives a map change (map loader sub-object + full scene-grid clear).
conclusions: Live coords have exactly 2 direct writers, both in pump handler 0x422960 (death/teleport msgid 0x33/0x27A).
Tick 0x4294E0 (guarded by [esi+0x6518]) reads live coords every frame and calls 0x43D850(Y,X) then 0x43DA80.
0x43D850 = widget update + map-texture draw; 0x43DA80 = marker layers (player box, blink dot, object markers).
Widget D3D target rect {672,0,800,128} byte-exact = simulator map.minimap rect.
Map texture rule: mapid < 0x3E8 -> MMap.wil frame mapid; >= 0x3E8 -> FMMap.wil frame mapid-1000.
Death/teleport payload = map name ('.\Map\%s.map'), loaded via map-loader sub-object 0x574118; scene entity grid (0xE1000 bytes) cleared (map change).
